title: Temple of Arkkoran

'''Temple of Arkkoran''' {{co|78|38|Azshara}} is located on the northeastern shores of [[Azshara]] and is where [[Arkkoroc]], the supposed god of the [[sea giant]]s, resides. He can be found at the top level and is not {{hostile}}; the temple, however, is guarded by [[murloc]]s and [[makrura]] who will attack you on sight. The [[Shattered Strand]], which the temple is located on, is also under watch by [[hydra]]s and aggressive [[sea giant]]s. This was once a [[Temple of Elune]].

The temple is a popular [[farming]] spot because of the [[Stormshroud Armor]] patterns and [[Golden Pearl]]s that drop there.

Mobs Found Here:

*[[Arkkoran Muckdweller]]
*[[Arkkoran Pincer]]
